policy_rule: specials + 256 byte tokens + every token observed in the 723 training notes + Vietnamese-compatible tokens with BPE merge rank < 8000, closed under merge parents. Built from the BamiBERT vocab/merges and training notes only.
choice_rationale: Largest size reduction among policies that keep the pretraining-frequent Vietnamese vocabulary (rank < 8000) rather than training-only coverage; the hand-written OOV list (not test/probe) changes in 4/40 strings at rank 12000 and grows quickly below 6000. Test/probe coverage numbers were reported, not tuned against.
training: same pretrained init as distillation-v2 (BamiBERT layers 2,5,8,11 + fresh seeded heads), then position table truncated to 34 rows and vocabulary pruned to 8,338 rows (exact row copies), then the distillation-v2 supervised recipe unchanged: lr 5e-5, head lr 1e-3, 40 epochs, batch 8, warmup 0.1, weight decay 0.01, dropout 0.1, last epoch kept; seeds 1,2,3; no KD.
position_only_arm: not retrained: truncation is bitwise lossless and rows >= 34 are never indexed, so it is functionally the baseline (verified on the trained baselines).
